newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rohlig France to open new offices in Lyon.
newsitem.headline: Rohlig France to open new offices in Lyon.

text.p: Rohlig France, the French arm of German sea and air freight forwarders, Rohlig, said it planned to open an office at Lyon-Satolas airport during the course of 1997. Rohlig France opened an office at Paris/CDG airport on January 1 1996.

"Lyon is France's second economic centre after Paris and the best way to build on the business we already have in the region is to locate there," said Rohlig France managing director, Jacques Thevenet.
"The company will probably employ three to four staff at the proposed Lyon office" he added.
Rohlig France' 1996 turnover totalled around 36 million francs, a third of which was generated by airfreight.
Rohlig France's major export markets are Australia, the Far East, South Africa and New Zealand.
Rohlig and French forwarders, Logfret, each have a 40 percent shareholding in Rohlig France while Jacques Thevenet has a 20 percent stake. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
